query:
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, event_id, kind)
           SELECT e.host_id, $2, e.id, ($3::text)::notification_kind
           FROM events e
           WHERE e.id = $1
             AND e.host_id <> $2
             AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM event_mutes m
               WHERE m.user_id = e.host_id AND m.event_id = e.id
             )
